name: Virtual PRO
what_it_is: An enterprise virtual and hybrid event platform for conference producers and corporate event teams, built by Brandlive (the product formerly sold under the Hubilo address redirects here).
platforms: Web platform; HD streaming with adaptive bitrates
pricing: Annual plans: PRO 1 $15,000 per year, PRO 4 $50,000 per year, PRO 10 $125,000 per year, PRO max on request; every plan has unlimited events and pricing scales with admin seats.
notable: Company page names Brandlive, Inc., Portland, Oregon
Offices listed: Portland, Los Angeles, Chicago, London, Bengaluru

facts.fact: Virtual PRO describes itself as the enterprise virtual and hybrid event platform for conference producers and corporate event teams, built for multi-session, multi-day events.
The pricing page lists PRO 1 at $15,000 per year, PRO 4 at $50,000 per year and PRO 10 at $125,000 per year, with PRO max through sales; every plan has unlimited events.
Audience caps per event are 1,000 on PRO 1, 4,000 on PRO 4, 10,000 on PRO 10 and 40,000 on PRO max.
The company page says Virtual PRO is built by Brandlive and gives a Portland, Oregon address under Brandlive, Inc.
The homepage lists HD streaming with adaptive bitrates, multilingual captions and real-time CRM integrations with HubSpot, Salesforce and Marketo.
